_help.usage: Copy this file as fs-spacemaker.config.json next to fs-spacemaker.exe (or pass --config). Every key is optional; command-line options win over this file.
_help.scan_threads: Parallel file reads during scan (default: CPU count, at most 8). Use 1-2 for a single mechanical hard disk.
_help.partial_hash_bytes: Bytes read from the start of a file for the cheap pre-filter (default 65536, minimum 4096).
_help.excluded_names: File or folder names never inventoried on either side (case-insensitive).
_help.report_max_rows: Maximum rows per table in report.html, largest first (report.csv always has every row).
_help.include_empty_files: Content mode only: also delete empty source files (they free no space). Default false.
_help.delete_read_only: Also delete read-only source files. Default false (they are protected).
_help.remove_emptied_dirs: Remove source folders emptied by the deletions (never folders that were already empty). Default true.
_help.work_dir: Folder for the index, plans and reports (default: fs-spacemaker-work next to the executable).
